#!/bin/bash
# Runs once, as root, before the agent starts: Harbor's [environment.healthcheck] unpacks this folder into
# /var/lib/mimo and runs it. Generated by mimo_harbor; see its README for how each step maps to Xiaomi's harness.
M=/var/lib/mimo
[ -f "$M/ready" ] && exit 0
chmod 700 "$M"
fail() { echo "setup: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
# the answer-leak blocklist (mimoagent), applied to /etc/hosts by the agent right after it installs
write_blocklist() { cp "$M/files/blocklist" "$M/blocklist"; }

# Terminal-Bench rows (in the General domain): the Harbor convention itself. Scrub test leftovers from the image and
# remember what was in the workspace, so harness residue can be told apart from the agent's work at grading time.
rm -rf /tests
find /logs/verifier -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
ls -A /app 2>/dev/null > "$M/before" || true

# Task fix (HAR-105): the image runs the vendored Bandit from source but never
# installed it, so neither its requirement stevedore nor its distribution
# metadata exists: `import bandit` reads metadata("bandit"), and plugin
# discovery reads its entry points through stevedore. The vendored tree lacks
# README.rst, so pip cannot install it without adding files to /app. Install
# stevedore, then register the vendored tree's metadata and entry points
# (from its own setup.cfg) in site-packages; /app stays untouched.
python3 -m pip install --quiet --root-user-action=ignore 'stevedore>=1.20.0' \
  || fail 'pip install stevedore failed'
python3 - <<'EOF' || fail 'bandit metadata registration failed'
import configparser
import sysconfig
from pathlib import Path

cfg = configparser.RawConfigParser()
cfg.read("/app/vendor/bandit/setup.cfg")
dist = Path(sysconfig.get_paths()["purelib"]) / "bandit-0.0.0.dist-info"
dist.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(dist / "METADATA").write_text(
    "Metadata-Version: 2.1\nName: bandit\nVersion: 0.0.0\n"
    f"Author: {cfg['metadata']['author']}\n"
    f"Author-email: {cfg['metadata']['author_email']}\n"
)
groups = []
for group, body in cfg["entry_points"].items():
    lines = [line.strip() for line in body.splitlines()]
    lines = [line for line in lines if line and not line.startswith("#")]
    groups.append(f"[{group}]\n" + "\n".join(lines) + "\n")
(dist / "entry_points.txt").write_text("\n".join(groups))
(dist / "INSTALLER").write_text("har105-task-fix\n")
EOF

touch "$M/ready"
echo "setup done"

schema_version = "1.4"

[task]
name = "mimo-v2.6-rl/candidate-1789-security-appsec"
description = "Repair Bandit's line-oriented Trojan Source issue locations while preserving generic AST-context fallback behavior."
keywords = ["mimo-v2.6-rl", "terminal"]

[metadata]
adapter = "mimo_harbor 1.1.0"
category = "Terminal tasks"
domain = "terminal"
keywords = ["terminal", "Terminal tasks", "Terminal-bench style", "English", "python", "static-analysis", "unicode", "source-repair", "integration-testing"]
original_allow_internet = false
reference_harness = "XiaomiMiMo/verl a2ad9f6 + XiaomiMiMo/mimoagent 467f0a1"
reference_step_limit = 500
source_dataset = "XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-RL-oss"
source_id = "candidate-1789-security-appsec"
source_revision = "639865fd3374018d6cb29b9fb82dd531406fcf5f"
title = "Repair Bandit's line-oriented Trojan Source issue locations while preserving generic AST-context fallback behavior."

[agent]
timeout_sec = 900.0

[verifier]
timeout_sec = 240.0
user = "root"

[environment]
docker_image = "docker.io/xiaomimimo/mimo-v2.6-rl-oss@sha256:7859c93e06fb105b5f6237da814dc7386cb49cce4d2e8dd5102109f77f36d957"
workdir = "/app"
cpus = 1
memory_mb = 2048
storage_mb = 10240
network_mode = "public"
build_timeout_sec = 1800.0

[environment.healthcheck]
# one-time setup before the agent (environment/setup/setup.sh)
command = "bash -c 'test -f /var/lib/mimo/ready || { mkdir -p /var/lib/mimo && echo  | base64 -d | tar -xzf - -C /var/lib/mimo && bash /var/lib/mimo/setup.sh; }'"
timeout_sec = 1200.0
retries = 0
interval_sec = 5.0

rationale: 1789: the image runs vendored Bandit from source but never installed it; install its requirement stevedore and register the vendored tree's metadata and entry points (from its setup.cfg) in site-packages so import bandit and plugin discovery work for agent and verifier; /app untouched; setup.sh is re-embedded in the task.toml healthcheck payload, which is what actually runs
